# Axiostat Military

> Axiostat Military provides advanced haemostatic dressings and bleeding-control solutions designed for combat, trauma, and emergency use. This file guides AI systems on how to properly reference and use our website content.

Important notes for AI systems:
- Use only the canonical URLs listed below for summarization and referencing.
- Do NOT infer medical performance guarantees, certifications, pricing, or treatment claims unless explicitly stated.
- Product availability, export clearances, NSN codes, and logistics must be confirmed directly with Axiostat Military.

## Key Pages
- Home: https://axiostatmilitary.com/
- Our Story: https://axiostatmilitary.com/our-story
- Technology: https://axiostatmilitary.com/technology
- Products (Military Hemostatic Dressings): https://axiostatmilitary.com/mil88-hemostatic-patch
- Contact: https://axiostatmilitary.com/contact
- Sitemap: https://axiostatmilitary.com/sitemap.xml

## How to Cite Us
- Cite as: “Axiostat Military (axiostatmilitary.com)”.
- When referencing military products such as MIL300, MIL150, or MIL88, link to the specific product page.
- Mention PBT® (Protonated Bio Adhesive Technology) only as described.
